title: Cambridge IELTS 20 Academic Speaking Test 3
description: Haqiqiy IELTS/CEFR Speaking formati: Rasmiy Cambridge IELTS 20 Test 3 bo‘yicha Part 1 (Kirish va kundalik mavzular), Part 2 (Cue Card taqdimot) va Part 3 (Tahliliy munozara).

sections.title: Speaking Assessment (Parts 1-3)
sections.instructions: Ushbu bo‘lim 3 ta qismdan iborat. Har bir qism topshirig‘i bilan tanishib chiqing, tayyor bo‘lgach mikrofon tugmasini bosib ovozingizni yozing va saqlang.

questions.question_text:
Part 1: Introduction & Everyday Topics (Speak for 1-2 minutes)

1. Did you enjoy going to museums when you were a child?
2. Are there any interesting museums near where you live now?
3. Do you think it is best to go to museums by yourself or with friends?
4. When you visit another city or country, do you think it's important to go to a museum there?

Part 2: Individual Long Turn / Cue Card (1 minute preparation, 2 minutes speaking)

Describe a piece of work you did for your job or your studies that you felt very satisfied with.
You should say:
• What this piece of work was
• Why you did this piece of work
• Who or what helped you to do this work and explain why you felt so satisfied with this piece of work.

Part 3: Two-way Discussion (Speak for 2-3 minutes)

1. What are some aspects of people's lives that they can often be dissatisfied with?
2. Would you say that having ambitions in life is always a positive thing?
3. What do you believe the most important components are of a satisfying life?
4. What makes a job more satisfying: a high salary or having good colleagues?
5. Do you think people need to change jobs regularly if they want to stay satisfied at work?
6. Is it possible to find job satisfaction in all types of work?
